result.title: TabK: Amortized Bayesian Estimation of the Number of Clusters in Tabular Data
result.summary: Estimating the number of clusters, $k$, is a fundamental prerequisite for most clustering algorithms. Traditionally, this estimation has relied on computationally expensive grid searches over internal cluster validity indices (CVIs) or adaptive clustering algorithms, both constrained by specific statistical assumptions. We introduce TabK, a zero-shot, permutation-invariant transformer architecture that frames the estimation of $k$ as an amortized Bayesian inference problem for tabular data. TabK leverages a novel Quantile Feature Encoder (QFE) to extract position-free, content-derived representations from empirical marginal distributions. By learning a generalized structural bias over a diverse synthetic prior, TabK estimates the number of clusters in a single forward pass per ensemble member. Evaluated across 50 diverse real-world benchmarks, TabK outperforms all competing methods, achieving a mean absolute error (MAE) value of 1.04 compared to 2.14 for the closest competitor. TabK also achieves the lowest average inference time, producing estimates in less than one second on average and running $2\times$ faster than TabClustPFN and $30\times$ faster than traditional CVIs such as Silhouette and Calinski-Harabasz. Code is available at https://github.com/mrbakhtyari/TabK.

AI.brief_summary: 提出 TabK，把表格数据的簇数 k 估计表述为 amortized Bayesian 推断：用置换不变 Transformer 配合 Quantile Feature Encoder 从经验边缘分布提取免位置、内容驱动的表示，在合成先验上学习通用结构偏置，每个集成成员一次前向即可给出估计，50 个真实基准上 MAE 为 1.04。
AI.relevance_reason: 与视觉多模态推理无直接关系，但其「在合成先验下摊销训练 Transformer、单次前向近似离散隐变量后验并以集成体现不确定性」的做法，可能为 LVR 中多种 latent 假设的生成与筛选提供可核查的方法线索。
